title: NASA people invite him to lunch during a US Congress visit

tellings.quote: When I was visiting as a member of the Russian Parliament in the United States Congress, um I received a call. Someone introduced themselves saying, "We're from NASA. We heard about your statement and would like to meet."

plain: Sometime between 1997 and 1999, during a visit to the US Congress, a member of the Russian Parliament named Kiran Ilum Xenov says he got a phone call from people who said they were from NASA, the US space agency. He tells it himself: they said they had heard about a public statement he had made and wanted to meet, and they invited him to lunch. He tells it as a sign that his account had reached people inside the American government.
